candidates.title: Glucare Plus detail page exposes placeholder copy in product tabs
candidates.observation: The captured rendered product page includes two tabs labeled “Custom Tab 1” and “Custom Tab 2”; the associated tab content contains generic English Lorem ipsum placeholder text. This is directly visible copy on this product detail page. It interrupts the product information flow and does not answer product-specific benefit, ingredient, usage, or support questions. The latter impact is an assessment of the visible copy, not a claim about product facts or health outcomes.
candidates.suggested_direction: Replace the generic tab labels and placeholder text with verified, product-specific information, or remove the empty tabs. Have any health-related claims reviewed by an appropriately qualified expert before publication.
unknowns: Whether the tab content is identical on other product pages was not established by this evidence.
No product formulation, efficacy, or medical claims were independently validated.

candidates.title: A Glucare Plus product card shows a zero price beside a separate 9,000 ₫ trial offer
candidates.observation: The captured visible text lists “1 Gói Sữa Hạt dinh dưỡng GLUCARE PLUS ...” at 9.000,00 ₫ and later lists “Sữa Hạt dinh dưỡng GLUCARE PLUS - Dùng được cho người tiểu đường” at 0,00 ₫ (repeated). The same page separately promotes a 9.000đ trial pack. These are displayed values on distinct entries; the evidence does not establish whether the 0.00 ₫ listing is intentional, a placeholder, or an error. This may leave shoppers uncertain about the price and offer attached to the product.
candidates.suggested_direction: Clarify which Glucare Plus item is the paid product and which is the trial offer; show an actionable accurate price for each entry and make offer terms clear beside its CTA.
unknowns: Whether 0,00 ₫ is an intentional promotion or placeholder.
Whether clicking either product-card action changes quantity, adds an item, or opens another step; no such action was performed.

planning.objective: Make the product and trial prices unambiguous before shoppers act.
planning.target_state: Each distinct offer has a clear product name, payable price, and adjacent action label.
recommended_changes: Review the displayed 0,00 ₫ Glucare Plus listing.
Distinguish the 9.000đ sample offer from the standard product offer.
planning.implementation_area: product offer content and visible product cards
developer_investigation: Confirm the intended price and offer terms for each Glucare Plus entry.
acceptance_criteria: The page no longer presents an unexplained 0,00 ₫ amount for a purchasable Glucare Plus item.
The sample offer and standard product offer have distinct visible labels and prices.
automated_verification: Inspect rendered product-card text and prices on the URL.

candidates.title: robots.txt advertises a sitemap URL that returned HTTP 404
candidates.observation: The captured public robots.txt names https://addp.vn/pub/sitemap.xml as its Sitemap URL. The run recorded HTTP 404 for that URL; it also recorded HTTP 404 for https://addp.vn/sitemap.xml. These are endpoint observations from this collection, not proof of persistent availability or search-engine impact.
candidates.suggested_direction: Check the publicly advertised sitemap location and publish a valid sitemap there, or update the robots.txt Sitemap directive to the intended reachable URL.
unknowns: Whether the 404 response was transient or persists beyond the run's collection time.
Whether a valid sitemap is available at another untested URL or through a sitemap index.
Whether search engines currently know or have processed another sitemap location.
Whether the sitemap response body is an application error page or another custom 404 response; only status and byte count were recorded in the indexed fact.
candidates.observed_problem: robots.txt advertises https://addp.vn/pub/sitemap.xml, and that URL returned HTTP 404 in this run. The alternate tested URL https://addp.vn/sitemap.xml also returned HTTP 404.
confirmed_external_facts: https://addp.vn/robots.txt returned HTTP 200 and its captured contents include 'Sitemap: https://addp.vn/pub/sitemap.xml'. Evidence: EVD-C51AC48D3DB98538.
probable_technical_causes: The advertised sitemap may not be published at the configured path, or the route may be misconfigured. This is a hypothesis, not a confirmed implementation cause.
developer_investigation: Verify the intended public sitemap endpoint and its response status and XML content from an external client.
Check that the robots.txt Sitemap directive points to the verified endpoint.

candidates.title: Product page provides question-led, extractable information but no dedicated FAQ heading is evidenced

unknowns: A full editorial assessment of all body content, answer lengths, references, and medical accuracy is outside this evidence-based finding.

candidates.title: Glucare Plus diabetes and blood-glucose claims need qualified review
candidates.observation: The collected product page uses the exact health-related wording “dùng được cho người tiểu đường muốn duy trì đường huyết ổn định”, “hỗ trợ kiểm soát đường huyết an toàn”, “Giải pháp dinh dưỡng lý tưởng cho người mắc bệnh đái tháo đường và tiền đái tháo đường”, and “kiểm soát đường huyết hiệu quả”. It also labels the product “DINH DƯỠNG Y KHOA ĐỘT PHÁ” and presents a sample-request form asking for the visitor’s current condition, with options including type 1/type 2 diabetes and prediabetes. These are observed public claims and form wording; this review does not determine their medical truth, substantiation, product classification, or regulatory status. Route the exact claims and their supporting basis for qualified human/regulatory review.
candidates.suggested_direction: Have a qualified health professional and appropriate regulatory reviewer assess each quoted claim, its supporting evidence, intended audience, and context; revise or qualify wording based on that review. Ensure any health-related lead flow has suitable privacy and consent treatment, which was not assessed here.
unknowns: No external source or product dossier in the allowed artifacts substantiates or refutes efficacy, safety, glycemic effects, or suitability for people with diabetes.
No regulatory determination or product classification was available.
This is a page-instance finding for the collected Glucare Plus URL, not an evidence-supported site pattern.
The artifact captures raw page HTML; the wording is present in the captured product-page content, but full viewport-by-viewport visibility was not independently assessed in this specialist review.

candidates.title: Diabetes article claims and medical guidance need source and editorial review
candidates.observation: The collected article presents diagnostic criteria and thresholds, including fasting glucose, HbA1c and OGTT, and discusses consequences of delayed diagnosis. The available page capture establishes that these statements occur in the article, but this analysis does not validate their medical accuracy. Refer the exact article content to a qualified clinical reviewer and check that the published article visibly identifies its author/editor/medical reviewer and its supporting sources.
candidates.suggested_direction: Request qualified clinical review of diagnostic thresholds, risks and recommendations; preserve a transparent evidence trail and visible, verifiable authorship or medical review attribution where applicable.
unknowns: Medical truth, currency, and completeness of the diagnostic advice were not externally assessed.
This raw HTML evidence ID proves collection of the article page, but does not itself establish whether all visible-text sections or attribution blocks were complete in the rendered experience.
No sitewide pattern is asserted; this finding concerns this article page instance only.

candidates.title: Homepage LAB load metrics are substantially elevated on desktop and mobile
candidates.observation: In clean-load LAB captures, desktop recorded LCP 17,700 ms, CLS 0.1651, and TTFB 5,911.5 ms; mobile recorded LCP 12,504 ms, CLS 0.1346, and TTFB 5,841.7 ms. Both captures state synthetic_scroll_before_measurement=false. These are single-run browser measurements under the recorded run conditions, not field experience. The measured LCP is above the checklist's stated 2.5-second target; no PageSpeed score was captured.
candidates.suggested_direction: Repeat comparable clean-load measurements on desktop and mobile, inspect the recorded network and resource waterfall for the LCP element and response delays, and verify whether the elevated values persist before prioritizing optimization.
unknowns: Field LCP, CLS, and INP are unavailable; these LAB values do not establish visitor-level Core Web Vitals.
Lighthouse/PageSpeed scores and interaction data were not captured.
No cause is established by the summary metrics alone.
These are single captures; run-to-run variation is unknown.

candidates.title: Required JSON-LD types were not present in the homepage and three sampled product captures
candidates.observation: The current-run structured-data extracts are empty arrays for the homepage and each of the three sampled product detail URLs on both desktop and mobile: valid=0 and invalid=0. The checklist calls for JSON-LD Organization, Product for three products, and FAQPage. This establishes that those requested JSON-LD types were not captured on these sampled pages; it does not establish absence across the full site. The raw HTML for the Glucare Plus URL contains Product microdata on the page root, so that sample does expose Product markup in a different format. No generator or implementation cause is inferred.
candidates.suggested_direction: Review the intended structured-data requirement against the sampled output. If the checklist is still authoritative, provide the requested Organization, Product, and FAQPage JSON-LD where the corresponding visible content supports it, and verify every claim against visible page content. Preserve and validate existing Product microdata where appropriate.
unknowns: Whether Organization or FAQPage markup exists on any uncollected URL is unknown.
Whether the three selected product pages represent all products intended by the checklist is unknown; the capture confirms only these three URLs.
The collector extract reports JSON-LD results; it does not establish complete microdata coverage on every sampled page.
